main_failure_modes: Low-confidence hindsight and utility findings are missed at the recommended high-and-moderate threshold.

main_strengths: All five findings localize to the correct substantive interview segments.
Four findings use exact or approved-equivalent target labels with full mechanisms.
No unsupported predictions, duplicates, false alarms, or fabricated quotes.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect segment detection and mechanism-first identification when low-confidence identified findings are admitted, while strict label scoring exposes one near-neighbor taxonomy error and confidence-driven misses at higher thresholds.
